No dollar figure is stated. The rep doesn't know it.

data.notes: The report got the core story right. The portal was the way in and the CFO's nine-day close was the reason. The deal turned on a value case built from her own data, the dollar figure stays unrecorded, and Fiserv's pitch stays unknown. Its weak spot is the gaps section: it calls the missing distributor reference and the undemoed counter readers 'survivable' rather than carrying them into the rollout as an unproven promise across 14 branches. It also adds some unsupported interpretation, such as calling the portal 'never a real build' and saying 'the processor' frames us as a commodity.
